description: dir on an oct key with alg A256GCM and an EC key returns the oct key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.2's one exception: for dir, a member whose alg is a content encryption algorithm (A256GCM) matches, the exact enc being checked at use; the EC member does not serve dir (§2.1); member 0 has no use (U = enc) or key_ops, and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
